Thermoreceptive_Pit_Organs.description: Clusters of highly specialized, heat-sensing pits located along the snout or upper lip. They can construct a high-resolution, infrared thermal image of endothermic prey, enabling pinpoint strikes in absolute, pitch-black darkness.

Jacobson_Bifurcated_Tongue.description: A deeply forked, constantly flicking tongue that physically gathers heavy scent particles from the air and delivers them to the vomeronasal organ. The bifurcation allows for precise, stereo-chemical tracking of fleeing prey.
